name: @mybase/sdk
description: Client helpers for apps running on mybase: analytics, cron calls, one-off tasks.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/analytics.ts src/cron.ts src/config.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && bun build src/analytics-script.ts --outfile dist/analytics.min.js --target browser --format iife --minify && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
